column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Mountain Pass and Rupirupi's Wound
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What an awful place.
My, my! Is a muscle-brained braggart like you no good at mountain climbing?
Shut it!!
This has nothing to do with the kind of strength I am good at using!
Sorry, you are right!
You are only good at smashing things and lifting them, after all!
Nyaah, nyaah! $$レブ$$-chan, so saaad!!
Damn it!!
Control yourself!
As fugitives, we cannot exactly take our time on the main road, can we?
But, old man.
Never mind us—$$ルピルピ$$ already looks like she is at her limit.
I'm at my limit too...
Very well. Once we descend this valley, we shall rest for a while.
Then I, the energetic one, will scout a little way ahead!
$$ルピルピ$$... You look terribly pale.
$$ヨハネ$$, you look as though you are having a rather hard time yourself!
Heh. I am getting on in years, after all.
Old man, we are heading on ahead too.
I see. My thanks!
Why? You should all go together!
That fellow is wicked, so he is being considerate of us...
Is that so?
Oh my, $$主人殺し$$ $$レブロブス$$ is being remarkably kind.
And as you can see, I am perfectly well!
Y-you idiot!! Tch... Let's go!
$$ヨハネ$$ and the others can take their time coming along.
Is it all right to say that?
Shut it!!
...It appears even $$レブロブス$$ has noticed...
$$ルピルピ$$.
Can you truly continue such a long journey while wearing that armor?!
I am grateful for your concern for me, but...
One day, I too wish to obtain $$大邪神$$ armor.
When I first saw that boy who spoke of $$愛$$...
I thought that treating even cowardly $$ピリポ$$ with what was called $$平等$$
made him an utterly wicked fellow...
But now I believe it was because he was such a person that he could wear that $$大邪神$$ armor.
That is what I think now.
And not only him, but $$ピリポ$$, who had been one of the $$弱者$$...
$$レブロブス$$, who kept pursuing the delusion called $$自由$$...
and even $$ガイ$$, who believes in the softhearted hypocrisy called $$正義$$...
The fact that they too could wear $$大邪神$$ armor...
Perhaps the most wicked hypocrisy in $$この世$$, in the terms of our Bible...
may be the $$七つの大罪$$ that hold the key to unlocking $$大邪神$$ armor.
Even before I began traveling with them, I would sometimes wonder...
whether this $$世界$$ created by the $$創世記戦争$$ might in fact be wrong!
To answer that question, I want to free the soul of the $$大邪神$$ sealed within the armor...
I must see it released!
And if you, who have already put on $$悪魔の鎧$$, should die before I do...
With whom would I share this vast store of knowledge?!
In our Bible, kindness too is a fine $$罪$$.
For all you say about them, $$お師匠様$$...
you have become quite a wicked person yourself!
Movie: “An arrow strikes $$ルピルピ$$”
$$ルピルピ$$!!
Old man, what happened?!
Aah... there is so much $$血$$!
No! We must leave this place at once!
Judging by the arrow's direction, whoever attacked us is probably above us!
